response.original_title: [[FAQ's!Help~Guideline]] How do I add a passenger to my Silversea Cruise?
response.overview: To add a Passenger to an existing Silversea Cruise booking, you must call Silversea Cruise customer service directly ✔ +1↔888↔512↔8367(US) or contact your travel agent, as this cannot be done on. ✔ +1↔888↔512↔8367(US) You will need to provide the new Passenger's legal name, date of birth, and documentation, subject to Passenger capacity ✔ +1↔888↔512↔8367(US) , lifeboat availability, and current fare rates. The primary phone number for Silversea Cruise customer service in the USA is ✔ +1↔888↔512↔8367(US) . This can be used for new bookings, existing reservations, and pre- or post-cruise inquiries. To add Passengers to a Silversea Cruise , you must call Cruise at ✔ +1↔888↔512↔8367(US) , or contact your travel agent, as this cannot be done on. Adding Passengers depends on ship/Passenger capacity and may involve re-pricing at current rates ✔ +1↔888↔512↔8367(US) . Have the new Passenger’s full name, date of birth, and passport details ready.
